meta.purpose: The date, spend words, toasts, the question card, the capsule.

label.purpose: Row labels, projects, the hint, the status, small buttons, the canvas bar.

code.purpose: Monaco's peeks, Diff tab and source panel on the canvas (12.5px, line 19px).

mono-data.purpose: Times, the spend figure, paths in the source panel's head.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The question card and the canvas's source panel.

motion.name: calm

motion.name: view-fade
motion.purpose: The canvas settling in place when it mounts (no sliding).

motion.name: resolve
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY(4px) to none, blur(4px) to none
motion.purpose: The one arrival motion for anything that changed.

motion.name: presence-orbit
motion.purpose: Only while the boss pane works (herdr: working).

motion.name: figure-roll

components.name: Button
components.description: The default button: quiet, outlined in a hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-s); font: 400 14px/1.55 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line-3); background: transparent; color: var(--fg); transition: background-color var(--quick) var(--ease), border-color var(--quick) var(--ease); } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--fg-3); background: rgb(122 162 247 / 5%); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Lit Button
components.css: .ds-btn-lit { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-s); font: 400 14px/1.55 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--blue-line); background: var(--blue-wash); color: var(--cyan); transition: border-color var(--quick) var(--ease); } .ds-btn-lit:hover { border-color: var(--blue); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The other answer: no border, fg-2.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-s); font: 400 14px/1.55 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--fg-2); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--fg); }

components.name: Today Row
components.description: A rail row: its state mark and one cut line; the project in fg-3.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 26px; } .ds-st { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--red); flex: none; } .ds-what { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-link { padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--fg); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--cyan); } .ds-project { margin-left: 8px; color: var(--fg-3); font-size: 12.5px; }

components.name: Toast Row
components.description: An in-app toast at the rail's foot; blocked, failed and urgent ones in red-line.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; column-gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-m); border: 1px solid var(--red-line); background: var(--bg-1); color: var(--fg); font: 13px var(--sans); text-align: left; } .ds-toast:hover { background: var(--bg-3); } .ds-toast .ds-st { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--red); }

components.name: Question Card
components.description: A download question with two answers; the only lifted thing.
components.html: Dictation's speech model, about 490 MB, downloads once.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-l); background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); box-shadow: var(--lift); } .ds-card p { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--fg-2); font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Capsule
components.description: The dictation capsule while the window is hidden.
components.css: .ds-capsule { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 16px 7px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--blue-line); background: var(--bg-2); color: var(--fg); font: 13px var(--sans); }

components.name: State Mark
components.description: 7px marks as herdr colours agents (0415): working yellow, blocked red, done teal, idle green; meetings and plain events blue, failed red, queued a mark-3 ring.
components.css: .ds-st { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-working { background: var(--yellow); }

narrative.overview:
The companion is one window beside herdr (0392, 0409). The work happens in herdr's panes; this window greets him, keeps today in view, speaks, listens, and shows whiteboard's canvas, where agents draw (0393). Jocasta holds a rail on the left (300px, up to 360px on large screens): her Presence, a greeting by the hour, one sentence on who is at work and how much awaits him, today's Calendar / Awaiting you / Landed / Underway / Next (0416, 0432), the day's spend, and at its foot how to talk to her. The canvas takes the middle. With a second display the window is the dashboard on it (0428): a third column on the right carries the clock and weather, the news, today's activity and the machine with Jocasta's services (0429). There are no thread tabs, terminals, boss chat, docked request cards, crew pills or projects sheet: those live in herdr.

The colours are herdr's and omp's Tokyo Night (0401), so the companion and the terminal read as one product. The layout, fonts and motion are 0369's: calm, typographic, light that falls on things rather than paint. Density is moderate. Surfaces are separated by hairlines and close steps of the Tokyo Night ground, not by contrasting panels. Only what asks something of him (the download questions) carries a lift.

While the window is hidden in the tray, holding Right Ctrl shows the **capsule**: a small pill window that says Listening…, Writing it down…, then Sent to the boss (0409).
keyCharacteristics: Tokyo Night ground (#1a1b26 for the rail, #232636 for the canvas side) with hairlines drawn from its overlay colour at 22%, 40% and 65%.
Blue (#7aa2f7) only as light: the Presence, marks, lines, short text, washes at 10%; cyan (#7dcfff) for text that takes the light.
State colours mean what herdr's Tokyo Night means (0415): working yellow, blocked (awaiting him) red, done teal, idle green; nothing else.
Mona Sans wide and light for the greeting; regular for everything else. Geist Mono for code, paths, keys and cost.
Sentence case everywhere; no uppercase or tracked labels.
Motion is event-driven: things resolve into place once; nothing moves while idle.

rules.name: The Still-When-Idle Rule
rules.body: Nothing animates unless something changed (0258). Arrivals use one `resolve` motion (fade, 4px rise, 4px blur clearing) and stop: the greeting's summary when its words change, today's rows, toasts, the download question, the capsule's words. Loops exist only while a live state holds: the Presence's echo (1.4s) while he holds push-to-talk, its orbit (1.8s) while the boss pane works (herdr reports it `working`), and its breath (1.1s) while Jocasta speaks. The spend rolls to a new value once (600ms) and rests.

rules.name: The Settle-Not-Slide Rule
rules.body: Nothing slides in from an edge. The canvas fades in place (220ms) when it mounts.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, every animation and transition of Jocasta's own parts ends at once (1ms, one iteration) and figures jump to their value. No motion of Jocasta's is exempt; whiteboard's canvas keeps its own reduced-motion design.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Paint Rule
rules.body: Blue is light, never paint. It appears as lines, marks of a few pixels, short text, and washes at 10%; the 7px meeting mark and the source panel's lit-range rule are the norm. Text selection (24%) is the one wash above 10%, kept for legibility.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: State colours mean what they mean in herdr's sidebar (0415): yellow working, red blocked (awaiting him) or failed, teal done, green idle. None of them is used for decoration or variety; a colour that appears means its state is true.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Regions are separated by hairlines and adjacent ground steps, never by contrasting panel fills or heavy rules.

rules.name: The No Capitals Rule
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere. No labels, kickers or headings are uppercased or letter-spaced.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every figure that updates in place (the spend, a reminder's time) is set with tabular numerals so it never jitters.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Literal Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is used only for text that is literally code, a path, a key, a cost, an id or a time; interface prose is always Mona Sans.

rules.name: The Raised-Means-Asking Rule
rules.body: Only a question waiting on him, or the source panel he opened over the canvas, carries a lift. Toasts, rows, panels and the capsule sit flat.

rules.name: The Glow-Once Rule
rules.body: Glow is a moment, never a resting state.

dos: **Do** take every colour from Tokyo Night as herdr draws it; change `palette.ts` with `:root`.
**Do** keep blue as light: lines, marks of a few pixels, short text, and washes at 10%.
**Do** use the state colours only as herdr means them: yellow working, red blocked or failed, teal done, green idle.
**Do** separate regions with hairlines and adjacent ground steps.
**Do** set the greeting in Mona Sans 300 at 112.5% width; everything else at regular width.
**Do** use Geist Mono only for code, paths, keys, cost, ids and times, with tabular numerals for live figures.
**Do** let new things arrive once with the resolve motion and stop; loop only while a state holds.
**Do** keep toasts as rows at the rail's foot, leaving the canvas side to the canvas.
**Do** send anything about a thread to herdr (focus its pane); the companion shows, it doesn't drive threads.
**Do** honour reduced motion by ending every motion at once.
donts: **Don't** bring thread tabs, terminals, a chat, request cards or pills back into the window (0409); they live in herdr.
**Don't** fill any surface larger than a mark with blue.
**Don't** use tracked or uppercase labels, kickers or eyebrows.
**Don't** add corner ticks or HUD ornament.
**Don't** animate anything while idle, and don't slide anything in from an edge.
**Don't** put a lift on anything that isn't asking him something.
**Don't** add a theme setting; there is one look.
